<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 141.115364, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 140.1081 Da. A formula that matches this mass within a few ppm is C₈H₁₄NO (exact mass 140.1075 Da). Therefore the molecular formula is C8H14NO.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H14NO</final_answer>
